source_evidence: Player exact 'Then we formalize at 4pm publicly, so that the people of Caereth knows both sides are working together and feel safe and assured.' Authorizes public conclusion of previously negotiated compromise, not additional V speech or expenditure. Both parties honor conditional pledges: commander formally rescinds unilateral demand, quartermaster and guild agree continuous authorized staffing and documented prompt distribution under lawful authority, signatures witnessed by Elara and organizer. Public meeting peaceful and functioning, attendees hear both sides cooperating, applause and visible relief from some attendees; no universal opinion or national policy change. Prepared OR-CR-CA endpoints satisfied through negotiated lawful custody, no forced combat or new roll necessary because parties already agreed in principle and no contrary intervening evidence. Both reward milestones earned and actually paid from established consenting guild reserve (833+1667=2500gp), no advance previously paid for this contract; purse40346cp→290346cp once. Guild confirms promised endorsement and introductions, prior early professional appraisal honored once. No invented specific magic item or other political/legal entitlement. D315~16:45 Caereth guildhall public meeting concluded peacefully. V directed formalization publicly to reassure people. Commander and guild quartermaster sign bounded emergency equipment-release protocol before gathered guild representatives and citizens; commander rescinds unilateral signed armory seizure instruction and publicly confirms guild retains ownership/keys/stock custody. Authorized quartermaster/deputy continuously available, prompt documented issue only of explicitly authorized equipment on mutually agreed lawful mobilization triggers, no new emergency powers or national legislation. Elara and district organizer witness. No violence, intimidation, civilian injuries, obstruction or unauthorized key transfer; meeting functions safely. Both accepted Defense of Caereth milestones fulfilled, guild organizer pays 833+1667=2500gp once from chartered guild reserve, V purse403gp4sp6cp→2903gp4sp6cp. Negotiated benefits now earned: guild political endorsement of V/House Vaishnavi for successful resolution, introductions to Assembly representatives, merchants/craftsmen/magic brokers; professional specimen appraisal already provided D315 morning, no duplicate entitlement or automatic magic item. Public goodwill among attendees, not universal city opinion, Crown award, permanent political seat or new House recognition. D316 afternoon Crown defense consultation invitation available to V and Elara; Elara standing representative. Crown frontier commission active, 200 advance already received, remaining300+1300 contingent. Kestrel original custody unchanged, Crown certified copies retained; Severin reply pending, other quest leads unaccepted. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi5/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Fenar59/59 AC14 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6 inactive; Cirren51/51 AC18 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 boots; Mara/Elara/horses healthy. Rest5/6 food21/feed28, conditional240gp loot sale unpaid. Dice delegated until stop. Await V next action after meeting.
